authority_order: current explicit teacher instruction for the specific job
current Curriculum Philosophy plus declared current philosophy amendments
current Algebra Framework front door plus current Framework amendment, this authority contract, and declared current course maps/policies/profiles
exact embedded Unit Assessment Plan for exact learning content
current executable task PM for procedure
assessment_plan_rule: Exact Unit Assessment Plan HTML owns Unit learning content. Legacy Exit Ticket/Portfolio wording embedded in older plans does not override current Quick Check/Checkpoint/recurrence policy.
mastery_recurrence_rule: Formal Intro/Review/Mastery placement and recurrence frequency are different. Unit 1/2 are opening exceptions; Unit 3+ aims for about nine meaningful section appearances across the Intro-Review-Mastery cycle, with late-introduced goals allowed nearby distributions such as 2+3+4 or 1+4+4.
warmup_rule: Twenty numbered Warm-Ups per Unit. Q1 Solve; Q2 Diamond/Factoring; Q3/Q4 planned I Can retrieval. Warm-Up retrieval is extra exposure and does not count as a mastery_recurrence_map section appearance.
quick_check_rule: Quick Check is one common four-question short-evidence artifact per section. The teacher approves four source architectures; A-D print versions are comparable siblings using safe deterministic variation.
checkpoint_rule: Checkpoint is a larger personalized six-question evidence event generated just in time. Its builder is owner-local at _algebra_teacher_tools/tools/checkpoint/checkpoint_builder.html; current private Portfolio state determines useful evidence needs; the reviewed Unit Bank supplies family architecture.
source_mapping_rule: Map the clean task/evidence job before judging student work. Approved Quick Check sibling JSON and private Checkpoint source maps are primary lineage authorities for their exact runs.
bank_rule: Canonical Algebra Bank is Mastery Goal -> exact I Can -> high-quality family pool. There is no current three-family A/B/C limit. Family letters are stable IDs, not stage/difficulty meanings. Prefer deterministic family generation when safe, but quality is the gate.
student_label_rule: Bank-derived targeted questions display exact I Can code + full exact I Can statement.
practice_rule: Practice 1/Activity Set 1 share target plan A; Extra Practice/Activity Set 2 share target plan B. Normal set size is 12, allowed 12-16. Each set normally uses four current Intro questions plus mixed recurrence from multiple Review/Mastery goals.
offline_first_rule: Approved maps/families/templates should be assembled deterministically/local-first when safe. AI/teacher semantic authoring remains appropriate for new family design, rich contexts, and pedagogical repairs.
portfolio_template_rule: Tools/templates/portfolio/PORTFOLIO_TEMPLATE_CONTRACT.json plus registered student/teacher HTML/CSS own recurring report structure and fixed recurring wording.
quick_check_builder_rule: Normal Algebra owner execution uses local _algebra_teacher_tools/tools/quick_check/quick_N.html. Approved section output remains in the Algebra repository as one HTML + one 8-page PDF + one JSON source map under the unit approved folder.
shared_teacher_dashboard_rule: Shared Algebra dashboard exposes finished shared curriculum/resources, including approved Quick Check outputs, but not Portfolio/email controls, personalized Checkpoint Builder, or Quick Check Builder.
